answer: Quadratic stake-age pricing makes sybils costly: each new account must lock 10 POA for 20 epochs, and the lock required of one funder rises as 10 x n^2 for its n-th identity. A tundra of fakes on one island of funding stays expensive, since the 10th costs 1000 POA, while an honest user pays 10. Pigment-like tagging of funding sources lets auditors verify the shared origin on-chain and slash the locks.
